2607.15105.title: Long-Context Fine-Tuning with Limited VRAM
2607.15105.paper_summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning reduces model and optimizer memory, but dense attention still makes long training sequences expensive. We combine Hierarchical Global Attention (HGA) with segment-wise backpropagation and tiered KV storage. Only the active segment remains differentiable in VRAM; older KV is detached into RAM or NVMe, and HGA loads a bounded set of exact historical tokens for each query block. On Qwen3-8B with 4-bit QLoRA and PG19, dense training on a 16 GB Quadro RTX 5000 fits 2,048 tokens but fails at 4,096, whereas HGA reaches 16,384 tokens with 15.28 GB peak VRAM. Under evaluation the same adapter runs through 131,072 tokens on this card; VRAM is not constant but grows gently with the resident chunk summaries, so RAM and NVMe capacity set the practical limit beyond these lengths. At the shared 2K training length, HGA-trained and dense-trained adapters obtain 2.7405 and 2.7383 nat under the same dense-attention readout, while the stock model obtains 2.9541. At this boundary HGA training is already marginally faster (217.75 vs. 207.02 tokens/s), and the HGA-to-dense throughput ratio improves from 1K to 2K; because HGA keeps the attended historical set per token approximately constant while dense work per token grows, we expect this lead to widen as context grows. Dense attention is used for the main quality and retrieval comparisons so that they measure the learned weights and remain compatible with standard generation frameworks. HGA can also be used for retrieval and generation; an optimized production-grade serving implementation is under development.
2607.15105.paper_summary_zh: 參數效率的微調減少了模型和優化器的記憶體，但密集注意力仍然使得長訓練序列變得昂貴。我們將層次全球注意力（HGA）與段落式反向傳播和分級KV存儲相結合。只有活動段在VRAM中保持可微分；舊的KV被分離到RAM或NVMe中，而HGA為每個查詢區塊加載一組有限的精確歷史標記。在配備4位QLoRA和PG19的Qwen3-8B上，密集訓練在16 GB Quadro RTX 5000上適合2,048個標記，但在4,096個標記時失敗，而HGA在15.28 GB的峰值VRAM下達到16,384個標記。在評估中，同一適配器在這張卡上運行131,072個標記；VRAM不是恆定的，而是隨著常駐塊摘要輕微增長，因此RAM和NVMe的容量設置了超過這些長度的實際限制。在共享的2K訓練長度下，HGA訓練和密集訓練的適配器在相同的密集注意力讀出下獲得2.7405和2.7383 nat，而標準模型獲得2.9541。在這個邊界上，HGA訓練已經略快（217.75 vs. 207.02標記/秒），而HGA與密集的吞吐量比率從1K改善到2K；因為HGA保持每個標記的注意歷史集大致恆定，而每個標記的密集工作增長，我們預期隨著上下文的增長，這一領先將會擴大。密集注意力用於主要的質量和檢索比較，以便它們測量學習的權重並保持與標準生成框架的兼容性。HGA也可以用於檢索和生成；一個優化的生產級服務實現正在開發中。
